story: LensFleet began with a simple observation: a status update is not proof. “Delivered”, “visited”, “patrolled”, “on site” are claims, and every dispute, insurance claim and complaint starts with a claim nobody can check.

We put a lens on the movement — a dashcam on the bus, a body camera on the guard or carer, a tracker on the generator or the dog — and turn the claim into something you can see, place on a map, timestamp and share. One platform serves six sectors: logistics, security, care, pets, creators and assets. Sentinel is the product for organisations; LensFleet Home is the product for households.
mission: To give any organisation or household a camera-enabled, location-aware platform that records what happened, where and when, protects that record, and lets it be shared with exactly the people who need to see it — no more, no less.
vision: A world in which the movement of people, goods and services is transparent, trusted and verifiable, so that the people who depend on it can act on evidence rather than assumption.
